title: PR #118 — rewrite the onboarding docs
summary: Splits one 900-word README onboarding section into a task-shaped guide plus a reference page, and adds a glossary the guide links into. The rewrite lands the lede at the top and moves every environment-variable table out of the narrative. It also leaves one claim about token lifetime that nothing in the repo backs, and one section nobody links to.

nodes.label: onboarding.md
nodes.summary: The new task-shaped guide: get a laptop from zero to a running dev server in nine steps. It carries only what a first-day engineer needs in order, and links out for everything else.
details: opens with the outcome and the time it takes, before any prose
every step ends in a check the reader can run
the environment-variable table moved to reference.md:12

nodes.label: reference.md
nodes.summary: Lookup material pulled out of the old README: environment variables, ports, and the service matrix. Nothing here is meant to be read top to bottom.
details: holds the table that used to interrupt the walkthrough

nodes.label: glossary.md
nodes.summary: Eleven terms the guide uses without explaining. Added so the guide can stay short and still be readable by someone on day one.

nodes.label: README.md
nodes.summary: Loses its whole onboarding section, which is now three files. What is left is a project description and a link to the guide.
details: the removed section was 604 words of mixed task and reference

nodes.label: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Untouched, but it still points at the README anchor the rewrite deleted. That link is now dead.

nodes.label: Before you start
nodes.summary: Prerequisites, stated as a checklist. Names the access the reader must already have, so a missing SSO account fails on line one instead of at step six.

nodes.label: Run the dev server
nodes.summary: The nine steps. Each one is a command plus the output that means it worked. This is the section the whole page exists for.
details: step 4 links into the glossary for 'tenant seed'

nodes.label: Tokens and sessions
nodes.summary: Explains the local auth token. Nothing in the repo links to this section, and its central claim about token lifetime is not backed anywhere.
details: no inbound link from the guide's own step list

nodes.label: Environment variables
nodes.summary: The table lifted verbatim out of the README walkthrough. Same rows, now somewhere a reader can come back to.

nodes.label: tenant seed
nodes.summary: Defines the one term the guide could not avoid using in step 4.

nodes.label: Getting started
nodes.summary: The old everything-section: setup steps, the variable table, and three paragraphs of history in one run. Deleted and split three ways.

patterns.name: Diátaxis role
patterns.intent: Splits one document that was doing two jobs into a how-to and a reference, so the walkthrough can stay short and the table can stay complete.

evidence.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+## Run the dev server
+
+1. `pnpm install`
+2. `cp .env.example .env` and fill AUTH_SECRET
+3. `pnpm dev:seed` — the output ends with "seeded 3 tenants"
+4. `pnpm dev` — open localhost:3000/health, it returns ok
evidence.explanation: Steps only. No lookup table interrupts the walkthrough, which is the split this PR exists to make.

patterns.name: Inverted pyramid
patterns.intent: Puts the outcome and the time cost in the first two lines, so a reader can decide to stop before spending an hour.
